summary: Frontend-only verification of the Staff Onboarding 'Create Onboarding Case' wizard dropdown/calendar conversion. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, navigated to Operations → Staffing → People → Staff Onboarding, opened the wizard, walked through all 3 steps and created a case. All specified inputs match the requested control types and the created case appears in the list and opens on Overview reflecting the chosen values.

step2.wizard-department: SELECT — opts: Select…, Service, Sales, Operations, Installation, Warehouse / Stores, Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, Customer Support, Management, Admin ✓
step2.wizard-etype: SELECT — opts: Select…, Permanent full time, Permanent part time, Fixed-term contract, Temporary, Apprenticeship, Zero-hours, Consultant / Contractor ✓
step2.wizard-probation: SELECT — opts: Select…, None, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, 12 months ✓
step2.wizard-notice: SELECT — opts: Select…, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 6 months ✓
step2.wizard-holiday: SELECT — opts: Select…, 20 days, 22 days, 25 days, 28 days (incl. bank holidays), 30 days, 33 days (incl. bank holidays) ✓

verification_details.step3: Package cards render with testids pkg-standard / pkg-engineer / pkg-warehouse / pkg-office / pkg-sales / pkg-manager / pkg-director / pkg-temporary / pkg-custom. Clicked pkg-standard.
verification_details.create_case: wizard-create-case POST → success. Case 'TESTQA DropdownTester — Not Started' opened on Overview showing Position: QA Engineer, Company/site: TEST QA Ltd · Demo Head Office, Salary: 45000, Package: standard. Full onboarding-cases list now shows 5 items including the new TESTQA record.
verification_details.regression: Templates button opens 'Offer & Contract Templates' modal cleanly (screenshot captured). Settings button is present in the toolbar (test cut short by Templates modal still open, but no JS errors observed and both buttons rendered/clickable). Console produces only 3 pre-existing CSP warnings for emergent-main.js/posthog/cloudflareinsights that are unrelated to this change.

action_items: Optional cleanup: delete the leftover TESTQA DropdownTester onboarding case (my /api/staff-onboarding/cases DELETE cleanup returned 0 matches because the list payload didn't expose legal_first_name at the top level — case was left in the list).

Overview panel does not display Employment type / Probation / Notice / Holiday / Line manager / Signatory / Dept / Hours values — only Position, Company/site, Salary, Package. This is pre-existing behaviour, but if these dropdown values should be visually confirmed on the Overview tab they need to be surfaced there.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffOnboarding.js is 935 lines and mixes list view + case detail + wizard + modal components — should be split into ≥3 files for maintainability (WizardComponents, CaseWizard, CaseDetail).
Templates modal (z-[200]) is not dismissed by the Escape key, only by clicking the × icon — consider adding onKeyDown Escape handler for a11y & smoother regression testing.
seed_data_creation: Created one onboarding case 'TESTQA DropdownTester' (package=standard) — cleanup attempt via /api/staff-onboarding/cases DELETE didn't match (list schema mismatch); safe to delete manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard route lives inside DashboardPage tab=staffing → People sub-tab → Staff Onboarding leaf. There is no direct /staffing/onboarding URL; navigate via /dashboard?tab=staffing then click People → Staff Onboarding. Package cards in Step 3 use testids pkg-<key> (not wizard-pkg-*). Combo fields (ec/site/line_manager/signatory) are HTML datalist-backed inputs — use page.fill() with any string. Native <select> options render on light background as intended (documented).
